aboutpara: Hi! I'm Ash, an IT student with a strong passion for UI/UX design and modern web development. My foundation sits firmly in design—crafting intuitive user flows, functional typography hierarchies, dark-mode themes, and scalable design systems. I focus on creating interfaces that feel clean, intentional, and effortless for users to navigate. At the same time, I’m actively building my capabilities as a developer. Learning to code allows me to understand what happens under the hood, ensuring my designs aren't just visually appealing on canvas, but fully achievable, performant, and clean when brought to life in code. Whether I'm designing component systems in Figma or structuring responsive code, I'm always eager to learn new technologies and bridge the space between design concepts and working software.
